title: Move LLM/listen configuration from launchd plist to .env (canonical source) — operator directive 2026-09-15
author: jill (operator-directed 2026-09-15, post YOLO false-alarm PRD review)
plan_section: V2-047 follow-on to V2-022 (env consolidation) + US-017b (secrets to .env). Operator directive 2026-09-15: 'Almost, but the LLM IP addresses and all the other stuff that are in the P list were supposed to be in the environmental file, they got moved from the environmental file to the P list that were never put there in the first place.'
trigger: Current plist (~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.farm.surveillance.v2.plist) contains 5 EnvironmentVariables keys: PATH (required by launchd), GATE_KEEP_DISK_ARTIFACTS (behavior flag), LISTEN_HOST (0.0.0.0), LISTEN_PORT (8090), VISION_LLM_URL (http://127.0.0.1:8080). Operator (2026-09-15) explicitly identified VISION_LLM_URL as something that 'was supposed to be in the environmental file' and 'got moved from the environmental file to the P list that were never put there in the first place.' LISTEN_HOST + LISTEN_PORT are in the same category — network/endpoint config that belongs in env, not in plist. PATH must stay (launchd requires it for binary lookup). GATE_KEEP_DISK_ARTIFACTS is debatable — it's a behavior flag, but it's not an IP/URL so it's lower priority.
background: Per US-017b (2026-09-08) secrets were already moved out of the plist into .env (gitignored). Per local-ai/farm-surveillance-v2 skill: 'tuning parameters, not private data' — env vars are tuning parameters, secrets are private data. Both belong in .env / .env.example, not plist. Per listener/daemon.py:_load_home_env (line 480-535): repo-rooted .env is canonical; launchd-injected values take precedence over .env. To make .env authoritative, plist keys MUST be removed (not just added to .env). The current behavior is launchd-wins → so if I only add the key to .env without removing it from plist, the plist value still wins and the move has no effect.

operator_guarantees.git_maintained: Each story lands as a real git commit on main BEFORE claiming done. Worker reports 'done' without a commit SHA on main = card failed. Reviewer verifies via `git log main --grep <story_id>`.
operator_guarantees.code_actually_written: Every AC is a re-runnable shell command with explicit expected output. Reviewer round-2 lens: checkout the work, run every AC verbatim, compare actual to expected. No 'looks right'. No diff-summary-only approval.
operator_guarantees.no_residue: After each story lands, .env / .env.example MUST contain the new keys, the plist MUST NOT contain them, and the daemon MUST boot correctly. Reviewer round-3 lens: `grep` for each moved key across .env / .env.example / plist; verify daemon starts.
operator_guarantees.daemon_reboots_clean: After each plist edit, `launchctl unload && launchctl load` must succeed and the daemon must bind to the configured LISTEN_PORT without errors in logs/daemon.log. Reviewer verifies via `lsof -i :<port>` or `curl http://localhost:<port>/healthz`.
operator_guarantees.camera_creds_file_unaffected: This PRD does NOT touch camera-creds.env (already gitignored, already separate file). Only the plist EnvironmentVariables block + repo-root .env + .env.example are in scope.
operator_guarantees.cameras_off_limits: Stories MUST NOT touch Reolink web-UI / camera-side configuration. v2-side fixes only.
operator_guarantees.plist_minimal_remainder: After all stories land, the plist's EnvironmentVariables block contains ONLY PATH (required by launchd) and GATE_KEEP_DISK_ARTIFACTS (debatable, see US-047d).

shipping_definition: (a) .env contains VISION_LLM_URL, LISTEN_HOST, LISTEN_PORT with real values. (b) .env.example documents all three keys with placeholders + comments. (c) Plist contains only PATH + GATE_KEEP_DISK_ARTIFACTS in EnvironmentVariables (or also empty, see US-047d). (d) Each story lands as its own commit on main. (e) Daemon boots cleanly after each plist change with `launchctl unload && launchctl load`. (f) No camera-side changes.
scope_exclusions: Do NOT touch /Users/jill/farm-surveillance/ (v1). OFF and stays OFF.
Do NOT git push to forgejo or GitHub. Operator reviews and pushes.
Do NOT install new skills. Use existing skill set.
Do NOT touch any Reolink camera web-UI. Cameras OFF-LIMITS.
Do NOT touch camera-creds.env (already gitignored, already separate file).
Do NOT touch listener/daemon.py:_load_home_env precedence logic (launchd-wins-by-design, intentional override path).
Do NOT remove PATH from plist — launchd requires it for binary lookup.
Do NOT delete the plist file. Operator-driven launchctl unload/load cycle is the migration mechanism.
Do NOT modify infra/camera_creds.py. Already loads from camera-creds.env correctly.
Do NOT change gate.py or quick_classifier.py. Out of scope for env cleanup.
design_principles: One key per story — surgical commits, easy revert.
Each story independently verifiable via re-running its ACs.
Plist is the LAUNCH MECHANISM; .env is the CONFIG. PATH must stay in plist (launchd can't see .env). Everything else is config.
Operator applies the .env edit manually post-merge (gitignored). Worker writes the .env.example edit + verifies locally.
Operator applies the plist edit manually post-merge (it's a system file). Worker writes the recommended new plist XML in a comment / markdown table, NOT in the actual ~/Library/LaunchAgents path.

AC3: cd /Users/jill/farm-surveillance-v2 && [ -f docs/PHASE-V2-047-DECISION-gate-keep-disk.md ] && wc -l docs/PHASE-V2-047-DECISION-gate-keep-disk.md | awk '{exit ($1 >= 10)}' (decision doc exists, >=10 lines)
stories.notes: Operator decision 2026-09-15: MOVE TO .ENV. GATE_KEEP_DISK_ARTIFACTS=true is a behavior flag, not an endpoint URL. Two valid placements: (a) keep in plist — minimal disruption, current behavior preserved; (b) move to .env — full consistency with the .env-is-canonical principle. Worker investigates current usage in infra/gate.py + telegram_formatter/, drafts a decision doc with recommendation, applies the chosen placement. Operator-direct followup if (b): edit plist; launchctl reload.

If keeping in plist, why is it different from VISION_LLM_URL/LISTEN_HOST/LISTEN_PORT?
